versions.content: The function FrIf_SendWUP shall wrap the FlexRay Driver API function Fr_SendWUP() by: 1. Translating (based on static FrIf module configuration) the FlexRay CC index Fr If_CtrlIdx into a tuple (FlexRay Driver | Driver-specific CC index Fr_CtrlIdx). 2. Calling Fr_SendWUP() of the determined FlexRay Driver module with the param- eters determined as described above.
